_purpose: Mirror-repo claim validation framework. Specifies exactly what an independent AI session (in a fresh clone, with no prior context) would need to run to verify the canonical claims of the Hs project end-to-end. The packet is designed so that any of three platforms (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok) can execute it and produce a comparable receipt.

claim_matrix.purpose: The set of falsifiable claims to be exercised. Each claim has a numbered INV-### in the catalog and a specific test gate. The pass/fail of the gate determines whether the claim survives this round.

claims.claim: The Hs decomposition is Aitchison-native — distances and projections respect the simplex geometry, not Euclidean naive space.
claims.test_gate: TV/Aitchison metric pair on the 101-dataset reference suite returns identical orderings of similarity within numerical tolerance. Pass = perfect rank agreement on all 101 datasets. Fail = any rank inversion.
claims.stop_rule_if_fail: Halt. Open issue. Do not promote downstream claims.

claims.claim: Formal change detection via Helmert basis (pivot coordinates) is sound — change is detectable as displacement in pivot coordinates, not as raw composition shift.
claims.test_gate: EMBER 2001-2025 9-country corpus run. 5 of 9 countries (AUS, CHN, GBR, IND, JPN) flag deceptive drift; 4 (DEU, FRA, USA, WLD) do not. Pass = exact 5-of-9 pattern reproduced.
claims.stop_rule_if_fail: Halt. Investigate engine drift. Compare engine version against push #37 lock (CNT v3.1.0).

claims.claim: Carrier-level attribution is recoverable — when a country's composition shifts, the engine names which carrier(s) drove the shift, not just that one occurred.
claims.test_gate: Run carrier-attribution on the AUS 2008-2014 inflection. Pass = engine returns coal-share decline + gas-share rise as the named drivers, both with magnitudes within 5% of recorded EMBER values.
claims.stop_rule_if_fail: Halt. Likely CLR/ILR transform bug. Check hci_shared/geometry.py against push #32 lock.

claims.claim: The yeast factor (4-phase classifier: dormant / activating / dominant / saturated-declining) classifies the EMBER 9-country renewables trajectory consistently with documented energy-transition narratives.
claims.test_gate: STAGED claim. Run the 4-phase classifier across 9 countries 2001-2025. Pass = phase labels match the qualitative narrative published in IEA energy-transition reports for at least 7 of 9 countries.
claims.expected_output_signature: experiments/YEAST_C1_run.json with phase labels per country per year
claims.stop_rule_if_fail: Note: this is STAGED. Failure does not halt the conference-window release; it is logged for post-conference promotion review.

claims.claim: The four binding doctrines (SEA, STP, CRD, engine-independence) hold across the repo — no engine reaches into the other; tests use the single test plane; reference data is canonical.
claims.test_gate: Static analysis pass: no cross-engine imports between HCI/ and HCI-CNQ/; both engines pass tests against the same reference suite. Pass = static analysis clean + both engines green.
claims.stop_rule_if_fail: Halt. Engine-independence violation is a binding-doctrine break.

execution_environment_classification.purpose: Per ChatGPT GitHub-connector session 2026-05-11. Different AI environments have different capabilities. The packet is run differently in each. Never upgrade inspected evidence into executed evidence.

environments.name: Claude with file tools + bash sandbox
environments.produces: Executed evidence in session; not yet public until pushed

environments.name: Claude mirror-repo execution agent
environments.produces: Executed evidence + receipt in mirror repo; cross-referenced into main via cross_check_archive

environments.name: ChatGPT with GitHub connector (read + PR draft)
environments.produces: Inspected evidence + structural advice; can draft PRs but cannot execute

rules: Pass requires: command exits 0, expected_output_signature is present in output file, and any rank/match criterion is met exactly as specified.
Fail requires: any criterion above is missed. Numerical-tolerance criteria use the tolerance recorded in OPERATIONS_PROTOCOL.md.
Partial pass is not a category. A claim either survives the gate or it does not.
If the run cannot complete (environment failure, missing data), that is a separate category: NOT_EXECUTED. NOT_EXECUTED is not pass and not fail — it means the gate did not run.

receipt_format.purpose: What a completed run records back into the repo.
receipt_format.destination: ai-refresh/cross_check_archive/CLAIM_RECEIPTS_YYYY-MM-DD.md (one file per dated batch of receipts)

promotion_rule.purpose: How this packet moves from STAGED to CANONICAL.
promotion_rule.rule: When a complete batch of receipts (one per claim in the matrix) has been produced from at least two independent environments (e.g., ENV-2 Claude + ENV-3 mirror-repo, or ENV-1 CI + ENV-2 Claude), and all claims show consistent pass results, the packet is eligible for promotion to CANONICAL in a subsequent push.
promotion_rule.conference_window_constraint: During Phase 5 (now through 2026-06-06) this packet is STAGED only. No promotion attempts during the conference window.

rules: This is not a test suite. The actual test suite lives at HCI/tests/ and HCI-CNQ/tests/. This packet is the claim-level wrapper that binds tests to canonical claims.
This is not a substitute for OPERATIONS_PROTOCOL.md. Doctrine governs; this packet executes against doctrine.
This is not a substitute for the catalog. INVESTIGATION_CATALOG.md is the master claim record; this packet provides the executable check for selected catalog entries.
